subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this PR show an exact-head live WeChat A+B QR-login run before merge, or is the focused Gateway lifecycle evidence sufficient for an explicit proof override?
rationale: The contributor cannot access a live WeChat setup, while repository policy normally requires real behavior proof for an external runtime PR; only a maintainer can accept a proof override or arrange provider-level validation.

options.title: Require live A+B proof
options.body: Have someone with a WeChat setup capture redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online and usable after account B login on head `45d3ddbe34caf767cd1111703c4fd0c567ae4619`.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the lifecycle tests, typecheck, and build evidence while owning the remaining provider-level uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live A+B proof
recommendation.body: Have someone with a WeChat setup capture redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online and usable after account B login on head `45d3ddbe34caf767cd1111703c4fd0c567ae4619`.
